singleMeasures.sql:
SELECT ((CAST(SUM(retained."__total_state_sum") AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(SUM(retained."__total_state_count"), 0)) AS "analytics_retained_state.average" FROM (SELECT
  analytics_retained_state.region AS "analytics_retained_state.region", MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.average) AS "analytics_retained_state.average", MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.total) AS "__total_state_sum", MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.samples) AS "__total_state_count"
  FROM analytics_retained_state
  WHERE analytics_retained_state.id < '0' AND analytics_retained_state.region IN ('A', 'B')
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.total) > '0' AND MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.total) <= '100') AS retained
singleMeasures.oracleSql:
WITH source AS (SELECT * FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_retained_state WHERE channel='keep' AND id < 0 AND region IN ('A','B')),
    keys AS (SELECT region FROM source GROUP BY region HAVING SUM(amount) > 0 AND SUM(amount) <= 100)
    SELECT  AVG(source.amount) AS average, COUNT(DISTINCT source.person) AS people
    FROM source INNER JOIN keys ON source.region IS NOT DISTINCT FROM keys.region

singleMeasures.sql:
WITH retained AS (
SELECT
  analytics_retained_state.region AS "analytics_retained_state.region", MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.people) AS "analytics_retained_state.people"
  FROM analytics_retained_state
  WHERE analytics_retained_state.id >= '-12' AND analytics_retained_state.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING MEASURE(analytics_retained_state.total) > '1000'
),
combined AS (
SELECT COUNT(*) AS __total_group_count FROM retained
),
join_keys AS (
SELECT
  retained."analytics_retained_state.region" AS "analytics_retained_state.region", retained."analytics_retained_state.people" AS "analytics_retained_state.people", COALESCE(CAST(retained."analytics_retained_state.region" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "__join_value_0", (retained."analytics_retained_state.region" IS NULL) AS "__join_null_0"
  FROM retained
),
domain AS (
SELECT
  analytics_retained_state.region AS "analytics_retained_state.region", analytics_retained_state.person AS "analytics_retained_state.person"
  FROM analytics_retained_state
  WHERE analytics_retained_state.id >= '-12' AND analytics_retained_state.id < '0'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
join_keys_2 AS (
SELECT
  domain."analytics_retained_state.region" AS "analytics_retained_state.region", domain."analytics_retained_state.person" AS "analytics_retained_state.person", COALESCE(CAST(domain."analytics_retained_state.region" AS VARCHAR), '') AS "__join_value_0", (domain."analytics_retained_state.region" IS NULL) AS "__join_null_0"
  FROM domain
),
distinct_0 AS (
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT domain."analytics_retained_state.person") AS "analytics_retained_state.people" FROM join_keys_2 AS domain INNER JOIN join_keys AS selected ON domain."__join_value_0" = selected."__join_value_0" AND domain."__join_null_0" = selected."__join_null_0"
)
SELECT distinct_0."analytics_retained_state.people" AS "analytics_retained_state.people" FROM combined CROSS JOIN distinct_0
